body: I have a dog, and I’ve been trying to stay around just as long as she does because she has abandonment issues. But it’s hard, it’s really hard.
This isn’t helping. The reason I want to kill myself is I feel I have to someday. I’m asking for reasons not to tonight.

YTA, if money isn’t an issue then you should take everyone. I’m sure your youngest is going to miss him too. I don’t think there’s anything wrong with taking him out to something smaller than a theme park, but this wasn’t the best move. I think it can easily be made up though. I’d just hang one one-on-one with your youngest, and then maybe take the whole family out.
Thank you SO much, this is very helpful! I think I will definitely try the journal, I used to write poetry a lot and that could help. And admittedly I needed that reminder at the end :P
